title: Peter Geoghegan
gist: A Prospect contributor index page for Peter Geoghegan, who writes the Democracy for Sale newsletter on Substack; all eight of his listed pieces sit on political money and access — who funds Reform, Labour's sleaze promise, donation caps, lobbyists at Labour conference and transatlantic dark money.

insights.claim: Every one of the eight listed pieces by the Democracy for Sale author concerns political finance or accountability — Reform's funders, whether Labour will cap political donations, Labour's broken promise to end sleaze, and lobbyists at Labour conference.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Identifies the reporting stream most likely to break UK political-funding stories that move party odds and policy risk.
insights.locator: Peter Geoghegan writes the Democracy for Sale newsletter

insights.claim: Transatlantic “dark money” is treated as a live link between Donald Trump and the British right, with a dedicated investigation on that connection.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Funding channels between US donors and UK right-wing politics are an underpriced regulatory and scandal risk.
insights.quote: The “dark money” linking Donald Trump and the British right

insights.claim: Reform UK is reported to ban journalists covering its funding, with a dedicated piece titled “Why Reform bans journalists like me”.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Press-access restriction by a rising party is a tell for opacity in its financing — worth watching ahead of donation-cap legislation.
insights.locator: Why Reform bans journalists like me
